title: B-XAIC Dataset: Benchmarking Explainable AI for Graph Neural Networks Using Chemical Data
abstract: arXiv:2505.22252v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding the reasoning behind deep learning model predictions is crucial in cheminformatics and drug discovery, where molecular design determines their properties. However, current evaluation frameworks for Explainable AI (XAI) in this domain often rely on artificial datasets or simplified tasks, employing data-derived metrics that fail to capture the complexity of real-world scenarios and lack a direct link to explanation faithfulness. To address this, we introduce B-XAIC, a novel benchmark constructed from real-world molecular data and diverse tasks with known ground-truth rationales for assigned labels. Through a comprehensive evaluation using B-XAIC, we reveal limitations of existing XAI methods for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) in the molecular domain. This benchmark provides a valuable resource for gaining deeper insights into the faithfulness of XAI, facilitating the development of more reliable and interpretable models.

translated_title: B-XAIC数据集：基于化学数据对图神经网络的可解释人工智能进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 在化学信息学和药物发现领域，理解深度学习模型预测背后的推理过程至关重要，因为分子设计决定了其性质。然而，当前该领域的可解释人工智能（XAI）评估框架往往依赖人工数据集或简化的任务，所采用的数据衍生指标无法捕捉真实世界场景的复杂性，且与解释的忠实度缺乏直接关联。为解决这一问题，我们提出了B-XAIC，这是一个基于真实分子数据和多样化任务构建的新型基准，这些任务具有已知的标签分配真实依据。通过使用B-XAIC进行的全面评估，我们揭示了现有图神经网络（GNN）可解释AI方法在分子领域的局限性。该基准为深入理解XAI的忠实度提供了宝贵资源，有助于开发更可靠、更可解释的模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于真实化学数据构建的B-XAIC基准数据集，通过具有已知真实依据的多样化分子任务，系统评估并揭示了现有图神经网络可解释AI方法的局限性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces B-XAIC, a novel benchmark built from real-world chemical data with known ground-truth rationales, which comprehensively evaluates and reveals the limitations of existing XAI methods for Graph Neural Networks in the molecular domain.
